ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.45:0.55 ratio of high-intensity white regions to low-intensity black/dark-grey regions across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white pigmentation is concentrated on the lateral halves of both lobes, featuring a mottled texture on the left and a more solid patch on the right. The medial region and peduncle interface are characterized by a solid low-intensity black mass.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central notch with a measured interior angle of approximately 50-60 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular trailing edge topography characterized by high-frequency jagged serrations and pixel-level indentations along the entire continuous boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edge leading to sharply tapered, upwardly swept distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct cluster of approximately 10 dark, roughly circular ring-shaped scars localized within the white pigment zone of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Fine vertical and diagonal dark linear streaks cutting through the white pigmented areas on the right fluke lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent clusters of textured, high-contrast calcified growths visible at both distal tips and scattered along the trailing edge margin.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique bullseye pattern of concentric dark circles on the right lobe ventral surface, providing a highly specific spatial signature.
